description: This file defines system configuration structures, constants, macros, and external function declarations for the Synopsys ARC IoT platform, specifically related to clock and reset control registers.

classes.name: sysconf_reg
classes.description: Structure representing system configuration registers for clock, reset, and power management.

methods.name: arc_iot_pll_conf_reg
methods.description: Configures the PLL register with a specified value.

methods.name: arc_iot_pll_fout_config
methods.description: Configures the PLL output frequency.

methods.name: arc_iot_ahb_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets the AHB clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_ahb_clk_enable
methods.description: Enables the AHB clock for a device.

methods.name: arc_iot_ahb_clk_disable
methods.description: Disables the AHB clock for a device.

methods.name: arc_iot_sdio_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets the SDIO clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_spi_master_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets the SPI master clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_gpio8b_dbclk_div
methods.description: Sets the GPIO8B debounce clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_gpio4b_dbclk_div
methods.description: Sets the GPIO4B debounce clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_i2s_tx_clk_div
methods.description: Sets the I2S transmit clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_i2s_rx_clk_div
methods.description: Sets the I2S receive clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_i2s_rx_clk_sel
methods.description: Selects the I2S receive clock source.

methods.name: arc_iot_syscon_reset
methods.description: Performs system reset.

methods.name: arc_iot_is_poweron_rst
methods.description: Checks if the reset was caused by power on.

methods.name: arc_iot_dvfs_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets the DVFS clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_dvfs_vdd_config
methods.description: Configures the VDD setting for DVFS.

methods.name: arc_iot_dvfs_vwtime_config
methods.description: Configures the VDD adjustment waiting time.

methods.name: arc_iot_pmc_pwwtime_config
methods.description: Configures power-up waiting time.

methods.name: arc_iot_uart3_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets UART3 clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_reset_powerdown_vector
methods.description: Sets the reset powerdown vector address.

methods.name: arc_iot_eflash_clk_div
methods.description: Sets the eFlash clock divisor.
